D: A heartbroken teenager tries to win back his girlfriend by beating the school's ski champion down the K-12.
P: Serve the mains when Lane starts his shift at the burger joint.
S: the paperboy chasing his two dollars
Thin fries soaked in cold water an hour, dried, fried at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce.
the French exchange student next door
Mini croque monsieurs: ham and gruyère on white bread with béchamel and Dijon, grilled until bubbling, cut into squares.
the ski slopes and the K-12
Gruyère and emmental melted into white wine with garlic and a little cornflour, kept warm, with bread cubes and apple to dip.
M: Lane's job at the burger place
Two smashed chuck patties, American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on a toasted bun, wrapped in paper.
his mum's strange cooking that wriggles off the plate
Chicken, mushroom and rice baked together in a creamy thyme sauce at 180C for 50 minutes, golden on top. Nothing moves.
W: Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan 1 minute a side, folded with sugar and lemon juice, or with sliced banana and melted dark chocolate.
K: the French exchange student does it properly
Fresh lemon juice with sugar syrup on the side and cold water to mix your own, the French way.

s.note: the paperboy chasing his two dollars
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for an hour. Dry well, fry at 140C until soft, then fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss with fine salt and pile into paper cones with tomato sauce on the side.

s.note: the ski slopes and the K-12
s.how: Rub a pot with a cut garlic clove. Warm 250ml white wine, then stir in 200g grated gruyere and 200g grated Swiss cheese tossed with a spoon of cornflour until smooth. Keep warm over low heat and dip in cubes of baguette and apple.

m.note: his mum's strange cooking that wriggles off the plate
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs and 250g sliced mushrooms. Spread 300g rice in a baking dish, add the chicken and mushrooms, then pour over 750ml hot stock and 200ml cream with thyme. Cover and bake at 180C for 50 minutes until golden on top. Nothing moves.

w.how: Whisk 150g flour, 2 eggs and 375ml milk until smooth and rest for an hour. Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan for a minute a side. Fold with a squeeze of lemon and sugar, or with sliced banana and melted dark chocolate.

d.note: the French exchange student does it properly
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug. Dissolve 100g sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. Put lemon juice, syrup and a jug of iced water on the table and let everyone mix their own glass to taste.
